name: s02-reproduction-driven
title: s02 — Reproduction-driven: the 3D cell from viva_mgen's simulated proteome
claim:
The reproduction's simulated proteome packs the SAME cell — 605/632 baseline
species present at comparable roster — but LESS crowded: protein occupancy
~0.04 vs the Maritan-faithful 0.144. The species inventory is structurally
self-consistent; the divergence is one of absolute abundance scale (the
reproduction's simulated per-gene counts are lower than the WC-MG published
numbers Maritan used), not of which molecules are present.
question:
Driving the SAME Maritan roster + structures with abundances from a viva_mgen
simulated run (rather than the published WC-MG counts), does the reproduction's
own proteome yield a structurally comparable 3D cell — and where does it diverge?
hypothesis:
The viva_mgen reproduction's simulated per-gene protein counts, packed through
the identical pipeline, produce a cell whose species roster and occupancy match
the Maritan baseline within the reproduction's known expression differences
(GTP-capped translation, Poisson decay), diverging mainly for the most
dynamically-regulated genes.
objective:
Run the mgen_structural composite with counts_source=sim against a viva_mgen
steady-state run's protein_counts, pack the cell, and compare per-category
species counts and occupancy to the s01 baseline.
description:
VARIANT (run complete). Same ingredient roster, structures, geometry (Maritan's
144.47 nm sphere), and packer as s01; only the copy-number source changes —
from the WC-MG expression proxy to the viva_mgen reproduction's SIMULATED
protein_counts. sims/run.py runs the mycoplasma_genitalium composite for a
short sim, reads its evolved per-gene protein_counts store (keyed by gene
symbol/id — normalized to MG_00N ids, 477/522 mapped), and packs the cell.

Achieved (600 s sim, real binary): n_placed 10,661; 493 species placed;
605/632 baseline species carry a simulated count; protein occupancy ~0.04.
FINDING: the reproduction's simulated proteome yields a structurally
self-consistent but LESS crowded cell than the Maritan-faithful baseline
(0.144) — the same molecular species are present, but at a lower absolute
abundance scale than the WC-MG published counts. (A longer sim matures the
proteome only modestly; the ~2x cell-cycle protein accumulation still leaves
the reproduction's absolute counts below the WC-MG figures, so the divergence
is one of calibration scale, not of missing biology.) FIDELITY CAVEATS as s01,
plus: the simulated abundances reflect the reproduction's early-cell-cycle
proteome, not a steady-state or population average.

expected_behavior.name: structural-sim-cell-comparable-to-baseline
expected_behavior.rationale:
The simulated-proteome pack should place a comparable roster at comparable
occupancy to the Maritan baseline, with divergence concentrated in the most
dynamically-regulated genes — evidence the reproduction's proteome is
structurally self-consistent.
